title: Mavci guardian acceptance corpus result
description: The outcome of running the guardian acceptance corpus against one plugin version. Written only by `state.mjs --record-corpus`, which computes `result` by running corpus-score.mjs over every case in the library and stamps `recorded_for` from the running plugin. Swept by state.schema_valid so a malformed record is caught by something that is not the writer - the same reasoning that put hook-run, unverified and the guardian records into that sweep, and it matters here because this file is the only thing standing between a doctor FAIL and a green tick.

recorded_for.description: The plugin version this result is evidence about. doctor compares it for EQUALITY with the running version - newer is as wrong as older, because it is evidence about a different component. Stamped by the writer from pluginVersion(); never supplied by a caller.

result.description: Derived from the scorer over every case, never accepted from the caller. There is no `not_checked` member on purpose: a corpus that could not be scored is not recorded at all.

cases.description: One entry per case in the library. The writer refuses a partial set, so a result carrying fewer entries than the library has cases was not produced by it.
